market.question: Will Gold (GC) hit (HIGH) $6,000 by end of December?

assessment.reasoning: Gold ~$4,620 May 4 2026 (much higher than I initially assumed). To hit $6,000 by end of Dec needs ~30% rally over ~8 months. Persistent Iran/Hormuz tensions, central bank buying, and inflation drove gold above $4,600. Continued geopolitical risk + dollar weakness could fuel further upside. Estimate ~32%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: 8-month horizon dominated by Fed/Iran/macro - hard to forecast
